hypothesis.name: Bidirectional Load Rate hypothesis
hypothesis.statement: The marginal value of continuous predictive reassignment is governed by the amount of simultaneous opposite-direction demand, not arrival intensity alone.
hypothesis.status: falsifiable project hypothesis; not a claim of established or novel theory

method.ablation: capr_static and capr share CAPR scoring and parking; only continuous reassignment differs

theory.candidate_law: continuous predictive reassignment value is conditioned by both demand intensity and directional mixing; bidirectional load rate is tested as a one-number collapse
